features.name: preflight warns when a session starts above several repos
features.description: Preflight warns when a session starts above several registered repos, whose hooks then do not load. Found 2026-10-23: ~13 hangar commits from ~/projects with no verify-gate run.
acceptance_criteria: preflight in ~/projects names hangar and atelier; inside a repo it prints nothing extra
features.verification: bash scripts/tests/test_preflight.sh && bash scripts/tests/test_global_hook.sh && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: Tests first: 3 preflight and 1 global-hook assertions failed before the change. preflight.sh now prints a WARN naming each target-repos.txt path under a non-repo working folder; global-hook.sh no longer skips start in such a folder. 25 and 20 tests passed after; run from ~/projects it names hangar and atelier. Two fresh-context reviews (correctness, security): no confirmed defects. Not handled, noted by the reviewer: a session started through a symlinked path misses the warning (registry holds physical paths). Spec step skipped: small hook change, described here; Jira gates not applicable.
